title: Got rejected by a game portal for “overall quality”, so I spent a Saturday morning rebuilding my AI-made clicker with Claude
author: Famous-Stable-8092
selftext:
I’ve been making a small browser clicker game called Toilet Plunge entirely prompting an AI. I describe what I want, play the result, and prompt back what’s wrong. Then we go again.

The first version worked, but it looked rough. Crazy Games rejected it for overall quality, and on [itch.io](http://itch.io) almost nobody came back after their first visit. That honestly stung, but it gave me a clear direction.

What surprised me most was the art. Every toilet, plunger, building and button is drawn by the AI as code inside the game. My job became being a picky art director: “the shadows are wrong”, “this button is cut off”, “the icons don’t match the shop”. The sounds and music are also made in code. Some of them were bad at first, though. The beast mode sound came out like a fart, and the coin clinks got so annoying I asked for them to be removed.

The part I didn’t expect was how much time went into small UX issues rather than big features. The toilet jumped a few pixels whenever a label appeared, and buttons got pushed off screen on some phones. The AI fixes things fast, but only after I notice and describe them clearly. Playing my own game over and over turned out to be the real work.

For retention I added a tutorial you can skip, offline in-game coin earnings while you don't play, a daily gift, daily quests, and a little city that builds itself as you earn and buy items with in-game coins.

You can play it free on itch.io: gamer82901.itch.io/plunge-like-your-city-depends-on-it

You can also play it free in the browser at [https://toiletplunge.com/](https://toiletplunge.com/)

I’m curious what do you think of the game and what other things would you improve or change?

Let me know in the comments.

comments.author: adonislu
comments.body: I found it quite fun! My only complaint is that the level progress caps you from buying stuff. This is especially noticeable since frenzy mode gives you a lot of money, forcing you to buy enhancements for things that are already at your current level. After that, your level stays the same if you don't click, even though I would expect the hired helpers to help you push through to the next level.

replies.author: Famous-Stable-8092
replies.body: Thank you so much for trying the game and for the comment! This is exactly the kind of feedback I was hoping for. I’ll take a look at this and publish a new version soon. Enjoy the game!
